case_title.quote: ASIM SHARIFF v. NATIONAL INVESTIGATION AGENCY
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: The present appeal has been preferred by the accused appellant
number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's discharge plea is decided; five accused were named in total, but the Court decides one.

accused_gender.quote: rejecting his application for discharge under Section 227 CrPC
accused_gender.reason: The judgment uses the male pronoun for the appellant accused.

accused_age.reason: No age for the accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described; PFI membership is an organisation, not a religion.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.quote: the accused appellant is the President of Bengaluru unit of Popular Front of India(PFI)
accused_occupation.reason: Only an organisational post is stated, not an occupation; Not stated is defensible.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record of the accused is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: his throat was slit in a single blow
victim_gender.reason: The victim is male per the judgment's pronouns.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not stated.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.quote: the RSS workers had organised a path sanchalan, and the deceased, who was dressed in uniform
victim_religion.reason: RSS affiliation is described, but it is an organisation, not a religious identity; Not stated is acceptable.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: No personal animosity admitted by prosecution; accused's PFI and the alleged target group (RSS members) describe an ideological opposition.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Admittedly, there is no animosity between the appellant and deceased.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: No-animosity point is right, but the value omits the alleged ideological/organisational rivalry between PFI and RSS described in the judgment.

offence_category.quote: for the offences punishable under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC
offence_category.reason: Murder under s.302 IPC is the main charged offence.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC; Sections 3 and 27 of the Arms Act and Sections 15,16,17,18 & 20 of the Unlawful Activities
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections listed match the judgment's charge description.

weapon.quote: hacked Rudresh with a sharp edged and lethal machete
weapon.reason: Machete is the weapon stated in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: witnesses of the Mahzar proce edings who provided some information like bank account details and call data records
evidence_type.reason: Documentary, call-record and recovery-type evidence described as prosecution material; the Court did not test it.

confession.quote: Accused no. 4 confesses that accused appellant was the mastermind behind the killing of RSS members.
confession.reason: Alleged confession appears only as prosecution submission; the Court did not rely on it.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Prosecution submitted the attack was brutal and intended to create fear and insecurity among people at large; the Court did not weigh these.
aggravating_circumstances.quote: brutually attacked by the accused persons whereby his throat was slit in a single blow
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment records prosecution's brutality and fear-creation claims, so 'None noted' overlooks facts recorded, though the Court did not weigh them.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The application filed under Section 227 Cr.P.C. by the accused No.5 is hereby dismissed.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Discharge dismissed and charges framed; no verdict reached.

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court after analysing the entire material on record confirmed the view expressed by the trial Judge
high_court_outcome.reason: Writ petition dismissed and trial court order affirmed.

final_outcome.quote: With these observations, the appeal is dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: No conviction or acquittal exists; 'other' is the only fitting category.

offence_finally_established.reason: No conviction exists, so 'None' is correct.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but refer to the accused without gender pronoun (e.g. 'nothing incriminating had been recovered from the accused').
neutral_facts.quote: nothing incriminating has been recovered from the appellant
neutral_facts.reason: Summary is largely accurate and outcome-neutral, but 'from him' uses a gender pronoun for the accused, which the rules forbid.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the punishment prescribed for the offences.

attempt_completion.quote: Rudresh was taken to a hospital wherein he wa s declared brought dead.
attempt_completion.reason: The killing was completed, as the victim died.

physical_harm.reason: Fatal neck wound from a machete blow, as described in the judgment.

number_of_offences.quote: for the offences punishable under Sections 120-B, 109, 150, 153A, 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Counting 6 IPC, 2 Arms Act and 5 UAP sections gives 13 charged; none finally upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.quote: there is a prima facie material of conspiracy among the accused persons
premeditation_planning.reason: Only prima facie conspiracy found; final premeditation left to trial.

motive.quote: to create fear in the minds of the people at large and to create insecurity and foster disharmony
motive.reason: Motive is the prosecution's alleged motive, correctly marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: frequent telephonic/mobile conversation between appellant(accused no. 5) with other accused persons
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on charge-sheet material of phone contacts, accepted only as prima facie.

witness_credibility.quote: truth & veracity of such conspiracy is to be examined during the course of trial
witness_credibility.reason: The Court did not assess witness credibility; it left veracity to trial.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is found or noted by the Court.

custody_duration.quote: Accused no. 5(appellant herein) was arrested on 2 nd November, 2016.
custody_duration.reason: Arrest date is stated; total custody period is not given.

trial_duration.quote: Order dated 2 nd January, 2018 ... dismissed by a lucid impugned judgment dated 22 nd November, 2018
trial_duration.reason: Offence, trial order, High Court and Supreme Court dates match the judgment.

legal_representation.quote: Kamini Jaiswal, Abdul Rahiman, Shereef K.A., Ms. Rani Mishra, Jatinderpal Singh., Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Accused and State counsel names match the judgment's listing.

investigation_status.quote: After investigation, the charge sheet was submitted against all five accused persons on 21 st April, 2017
investigation_status.reason: FIR, NIA transfer, chargesheet and framing of charges all match.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the Court.

appeal_history.quote: The said order came to be affirmed by the High Court on dismissal of the writ petition
appeal_history.reason: Trial court dismissal, High Court dismissal of writ, and Supreme Court dismissal all match.

prosecution_argument.quote: Section 15 of UAP Act covers both the act of an individual and a terrorist gang/association
prosecution_argument.reason: Prosecution arguments on s.15, s.20, evidence and confession match the judgment.

defence_argument.quote: Navaratri was already over on the said date
defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments on suspicion, lack of evidence, Navaratri date and UAP Act match the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the trial Judge will be justified in discharging him
legal_principle_applied.reason: Sift-and-weigh, grave suspicion and no mini-trial principles match the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Union of India v. Prafulla Kumar Samal & Ors. (1979) 3 SCC 4
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Four precedents and citations match the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence was imposed, so Not applicable is correct.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: any observations made shall either way not prejudice the rights of the parties during the course of trial
other_sentence_order.reason: Non-prejudice observation and dismissal of appeal match the judgment.
